summary: Proposal for saving a verified Agent browser action sequence and replaying it inside a bound Session through the existing browser authority, lease, fence and approval path, with outcome attribution, hand-off to the calling Agent, invalidation, secret handles and alternatives. Separately lists the current Station behavior the proposal depends on.
limits: Design exploration only; nothing in it is implemented. The pilot timing and end-mismatch observation come from one run of an external framework, not a Station measurement. The current-behavior section was checked by source inspection, not by executing tests.
checks: Read the proposal against the cited decisions, guides and sources, and kept all proposed behavior explicitly unimplemented.
